rationale: UK PM pledges Ukraine aid — modest reassurance for regional security; wildfires in France/Spain affect EU neighbors; oil price drop eases energy costs slightly.

top_events.title: UK PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
top_events.label: UK PM pledges continued Ukraine support
top_events.summary: New UK leader Burnham reaffirms military aid to Ukraine before Zelensky's visit, reducing uncertainty about Western support near Romania's border.

top_events.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
top_events.label: US-Iran pause attacks, oil prices drop
top_events.summary: US halts strikes on Iran to allow talks, easing Middle East tensions and lowering energy costs — indirect benefit for Romania.
